jobs.description:
Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

jobs.occupation: Dutch & French Speaking Banking Customer Support Officer – Relocation to Malta
jobs.description:
Working closely with the Wealth Support - Manager, you will be supporting our customers throughout their customer journey. You will be joining a fast-paced, innovative environment and a vibrant and dynamic team. We are driven by providing excellent customer service which in turn provides you with an excellent opportunity to grow and learn.

Our shift hours are between 9 am and 8 pm in combination with a hybrid working model, this adds value to your personal planning and work life balance. The role also provides the opportunity to gain a professional certificate in Bank Mediation (Febelfin – Wet Willems).

The selected candidate should be willing to relocate to Malta.

Duties and responsibilities

• 

Attracting new customers by answering incoming calls and responding to customer emails

• 

Responding and resolving customer queries and escalating technical issues, whilst finding and explaining the best solution to solve the problem

• 

Providing customers with information about the Bank’s products and services

• 

Following up on customers’ instructions including payments, placement of trades, transfer of investment portfolios, and account opening and closure

• 

Supporting the Bank’s marketing strategy throughout various campaigns focusing on savings and wealth products

Required knowledge, skills and experience

• 

Native Dutch or French - Dutch/French-only speakers are also encouraged to apply. 

• 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is a plus

• 

Previous experience in a customer service role will be considered an asset

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.

For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.

You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.

International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.

Functieomschrijving
 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 

• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 

• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 

• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles
• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.
• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 
• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.
• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.
• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.
• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.
• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.
• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.
• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting.
 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.
• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.
• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.
• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.
